result.decision_reason: Withhold after independent risk audit (learner-critical-answer): Both translations and the sense are correct. However, Malaysian Malay also uses “sistem operasi,” while “sistem pengendalian” is the formal/preferred standard. Labeling the relation simply as “different-common-word” may misleadingly imply the terms are mutually distinct rather than shared synonyms with a register or preference contrast. No false-friend contrast is applicable. Retain outside promotion pending a vetted correction and fresh current clearance.
